annotations.text:
Forage Library — welcome screen UX

Shows once per session on landing (replaces the empty dropzone). Two calls to action:
  • Start exploring  → dismiss, fall back to today's file picker / new note
  • See Welcome Note  → open 00-welcome-note.md in the normal viewer

Cherry (dark) theme shown — it's the default. Screen re-themes with the rest of the app.
